PRODUCT DATA SHEET

PRODUCT NAME: Italian Mated Queen  
PRODUCT SKU: QUEEN-ITA-MATED  
CATEGORY: Queens and Bees  

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:  
The Italian Mated Queen is a high-quality queen bee, known for its gentle temperament, prolific egg-laying capacity, and resilience to environmental stressors. This queen is sourced from reputable apiaries and is mated with selected drones to ensure genetic diversity and vigor. The Italian strain is well-regarded for its ability to produce strong colonies and abundant honey yields, making it an excellent choice for both commercial and hobbyist beekeepers.

INTENDED USE:  
The Italian Mated Queen is intended for use in honeybee colonies to establish or enhance population strength, improve foraging efficiency, and increase honey production. 

APPLICATION/DOSAGE:  
To introduce the Italian Mated Queen, follow these steps: 
1. Ensure the colony is queenless or has a failing queen. 
2. Remove the existing queen (if applicable). 
3. Place the Italian Mated Queen in her introduction cage within the hive, allowing the worker bees to acclimate to the new queen over a period of 2-3 days before releasing her. 
4. Monitor the colony for signs of acceptance and activity.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT:  
Avoid direct contact with bees to prevent stings. When handling the Italian Mated Queen, ensure you wear appropriate protective gear including a beekeeper's suit, gloves, and veil. Handle the queen with care to prevent injury during transfer.

REGULATORY STATUS:  
The Italian Mated Queen is regulated as a live organism under both state and federal guidelines. It complies with the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) and state regulations regarding the transportation of live bees. No specific EPA or FDA-VFD approvals are required.

SHELF LIFE:  
The Italian Mated Queen should be introduced into a colony within 24 hours of receipt for optimal viability. If stored properly, she can remain viable for up to 48 hours in a queen introduction cage.

STORAGE:  
Maintain the queen in her shipping cage at a temperature between 70°F and 80°F (21°C - 27°C). Do not expose to direct sunlight or extreme temperatures. Ensure she has sufficient food (candy plug) available during storage.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS:  
For technical assistance, please contact our customer support team at 1-800-BEE-PROD or email support@beeproducts.com. Our team of bee specialists is available to help with any inquiries regarding the Italian Mated Queen.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION  
The Carniolan mated queen (SKU: QUEEN-CAR-MATED) is a highly sought-after queen bee known for her exceptional productivity and gentle temperament. Originating from the Carniolan region, this queen exhibits strong foraging skills and resilience to various stressors, making her an ideal choice for both novice and experienced beekeepers. She is mated and ready for immediate introduction into your beehive, ensuring a seamless transition and optimal colony performance.

INTENDED USE  
The Carniolan mated queen is intended for use in honeybee colonies to enhance colony strength and productivity. This queen not only improves brood production but also contributes to effective hive management due to her docile nature. Ideal for pollination services and honey production, this queen is an excellent addition for beekeepers looking to improve their hive's performance.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE  
Upon receipt, open the shipping package carefully. Introduce the mated queen into the hive after ensuring that the colony is queenless or has a failing queen. It is recommended to introduce her during the evening when bees are less active to minimize stress. Monitor the queen's acceptance over the following days.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT  
Use caution when handling bees. Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves, a bee suit, and a veil to prevent stings. Avoid smoke exposure to the queen during introduction as it may distress her.

REGULATORY STATUS  
This product is regulated under both the USDA and state agricultural departments. Ensure compliance with local regulations regarding the importation and use of honeybee queens. This product is not subject to EPA registration, but it must be used in accordance with state restrictions.

SHELF LIFE  
The Carniolan mated queen has a shelf life of approximately 14 days from the date of shipment if kept in appropriate conditions. Post-introduction, the viability of the queen will depend on hive conditions.

STORAGE  
Store the queen in her shipping container in a cool, shaded area until ready for introduction. Do not refrigerate. Ensure that the container remains well-ventilated to prevent suffocation.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS  
For further technical assistance or questions regarding the Carniolan mated queen, please contact our support team at 1-800-555-0199 or email support@beeproducts.com. Our knowledgeable staff is available Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM EST to assist you.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION  
The Russian Mated Queen (SKU: QUEEN-RUS-MATED) is a highly sought-after bee product, known for its exceptional resilience and productivity. Developed for optimal performance in diverse climates, this queen is mated with drones from high-quality Russian stock, ensuring genetic vigor and enhanced colony survival. The Russian Mated Queen is particularly noted for its resistance to Varroa mites, making it a valuable addition to apiaries looking to maintain healthy bee populations and improve honey production.

INTENDED USE  
The Russian Mated Queen is intended for use in beekeeping operations, specifically for replacing aging queens or bolstering existing colonies. By introducing this queen into your hive, beekeepers can enhance colony strength, improve foraging efficiency, and optimize overall hive performance.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE  
To introduce the Russian Mated Queen, follow these steps: 
1. Locate the current queen and remove her from the colony.
2. Ensure the new queen is safely enclosed in her introduction cage for a minimum of 24 hours to allow for acclimatization.
3. After 24 hours, release the queen into the hive by removing the cork or fastening device on the cage.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT  
Handle with care to avoid bee stings. Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) including gloves, veil, and long sleeves when working with bees. Avoid direct contact with the queen to minimize stress and ensure her successful acceptance into the colony.

REGULATORY STATUS  
This product is regulated by the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) and is compliant with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FFDCA). It is classified under state regulations for transporting and selling live bees. Ensure compliance with local beekeeping regulations prior to purchase and use.

SHELF LIFE  
The Russian Mated Queen has a shelf life of approximately 2-3 weeks when properly handled and stored. Best results are achieved when introduced to the colony immediately upon receipt.

STORAGE  
Store the Russian Mated Queen in a cool, shaded area at temperatures between 50°F and 80°F (10°C and 27°C). Avoid exposure to direct sunlight or extreme temperatures to preserve viability.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS  
For any technical questions or concerns regarding the Russian Mated Queen, please contact our customer support team at (555) 123-4567 or email us at support@beesupply.com. Our experts are available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM (EST) to assist you with any inquiries related to bee products and beekeeping best practices.

PRODUCT NAME: SASKATRAZ MATED QUEEN 
SKU: QUEEN-SAS-MATED 
CATEGORY: QUEENS AND BEES 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION: 
The Saskatraz mated queen bee is a hybrid queen known for its superior traits including excellent honey production, high resistance to Varroa mites, and strong foraging behavior. Developed through selective breeding in Saskatchewan, Canada, this strain is praised for its adaptability to diverse climatic conditions and robust health. Each queen is guaranteed to be mated, healthy, and ready to establish a new colony or strengthen an existing one.

INTENDED USE: 
Saskatraz mated queens are intended for beekeepers looking to improve colony performance and resilience against pests and diseases. They can be utilized in both hobbyist and commercial beekeeping operations.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE: 
Introduce the Saskatraz mated queen to the nucleus colony or hive by carefully placing her in the queen cage within the hive. Allow for 24-48 hours for the worker bees to acclimate before releasing her into the colony. Ensure that the colony is queenless prior to introduction to promote acceptance.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT: 
While handling the queen, wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves and a veil. Avoid direct contact with the queen; use the provided cage to minimize stress and potential stinging. If allergic to bee stings, consult a physician before handling.

REGULATORY STATUS: 
The Saskatraz mated queen is subject to regulations under the USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) regarding interstate movement. Ensure compliance with state-specific regulations regarding queen bee transportation and sale, as some states may have specific quarantines or registration requirements.

SHELF LIFE: 
Saskatraz mated queens should be used within 14 days of shipment for optimal viability. Queens are shipped in specially designed cages that maintain their health and condition during transportation.

STORAGE: 
Keep queens in a cool, shaded area (ideally 50-60°F) during transportation. Do not refrigerate or expose to direct sunlight. Ensure that the cages remain sealed until ready for introduction into the hive.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS: 
For technical support or further inquiries regarding the Saskatraz mated queen, please contact our customer service at 1-800-555-BEES (2337) or email support@beesupplier.com. Our team of beekeeping experts is available to assist you with best practices and care of your new queens.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION  
The VSH Pol-line mated queen is a premium honeybee queen bred for optimal performance and resilience. Known for their Varroa Sensitive Hygiene (VSH) traits, these queens exhibit superior grooming behaviors and a natural ability to reduce Varroa mite populations within the hive. The VSH Pol-line mated queen is a valuable addition for beekeepers looking to enhance colony health, productivity, and longevity in diverse environments. Each queen is raised in a controlled environment to ensure high genetic quality and vitality.

INTENDED USE  
This product is intended for use in beekeeping operations to establish new colonies or replace aging queens in existing colonies. It is designed for beekeepers seeking to improve honey production and hive health through the introduction of genetically superior queens.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE  
Introduce the VSH Pol-line mated queen into the colony during late afternoon or early evening when forager bees are less active. Ensure the colony has an adequate population of worker bees for support. Typically, a single queen should suffice for one colony; however, monitor for acceptance and behavior within 24-48 hours post-introduction.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT  
When handling bees or queens, always wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE). This includes gloves, a bee suit, and a veil to protect against stings. In the event of a bee sting, seek medical assistance if you experience allergic reactions. It is important to work calmly and avoid rapid movements to minimize stress to the bees.

REGULATORY STATUS  
The VSH Pol-line mated queen is regulated under state and federal laws governing the transport and sale of live bees. Beekeepers should consult local regulations as certain states may have specific restrictions on the importation and sale of bees. The product does not require registration under the EPA or FDA-VFD.

SHELF LIFE  
The VSH Pol-line mated queen can remain viable for up to 7 days when properly packaged and stored. Queens should be introduced to the colony as soon as possible after arrival to ensure optimal acceptance and health.

STORAGE  
Store the VSH Pol-line mated queen in a temperature-controlled environment (ideally between 70°F and 80°F) and avoid direct sunlight. Ensure that the queen is kept in her shipping cage with sufficient food and ventilation until introduction.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS  
For technical inquiries or support regarding the VSH Pol-line mated queen, please contact our technical team at 1-800-BEE-PROD or email us at support@beeproducts.com. Our experts are available Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm EST to assist you with all your beekeeping needs.

PRODUCT NAME: Buckfast Mated Queen  
SKU: QUEEN-BKF-MATED  
CATEGORY: Queens and Bees  
REGULATED: Yes  

DESCRIPTION:  
The Buckfast mated queen is a premium hybrid bee queen, known for its exceptional productivity and gentleness. Bred from the renowned Buckfast lineage, these queens exhibit high resistance to diseases, excellent foraging capabilities, and strong colony cohesion. They are mated with selected drones to ensure genetic diversity and vigor, resulting in a robust colony that thrives in various environments. 

INTENDED USE:  
The Buckfast mated queen is intended for use in beekeeping operations, particularly for those seeking to enhance colony performance, improve honey yield, and maintain a healthy hive population. Ideal for both hobbyist and commercial beekeepers, this queen can be introduced to existing colonies to replace aging queens or to strengthen weak hives.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE:  
To introduce the Buckfast mated queen, first assess the colony's status. Remove the old queen if present, and gently introduce the new queen using a queen cage to allow for a gradual acclimatization period. Monitor the colony for acceptance over a period of 3 to 5 days. Ensure that the queen is released into the colony after acclimatization.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT:  
Caution is advised when handling live bees, as they can sting. It is recommended to wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including a beekeeping suit, gloves, and a veil at all times. Avoid exposing skin and sensitive areas. 

REGULATORY STATUS:  
This product is regulated under both state and federal guidelines due to the live nature of the bees. Compliance with local agricultural and environmental regulations is necessary. No EPA registration is required for bee sales under the FIFRA guidelines; however, ensure compliance with state-specific restrictions on live animal transport.

SHELF LIFE:  
When properly stored, Buckfast mated queens have a shelf life of up to 14 days from the shipping date. It is crucial to minimize stress during transport to maintain viability.

STORAGE:  
Store queen bees in a cool, shaded environment away from direct sunlight. Maintain temperature between 70°F and 80°F (21°C - 27°C) during transportation. Avoid excessive jostling or exposure to extreme temperatures. 

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS:  
For any technical questions or further assistance, please contact our customer support team at (555) 123-4567 or email support@beeproducts.com. Our experts are available to help with best practices and to ensure successful integration of your new queen.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:  
Oxalic Acid Dihydrate (CAS No. 6153-56-6) is a colorless, crystalline compound used primarily for the treatment of Varroa mites in honeybee colonies. This organic acid effectively disrupts the lifecycle of the mites, reducing populations and aiding in the overall health of bee colonies. As a supercritical fluid, it is known for its effective penetration into the waxcapping and brood, providing a targeted approach to mite management.

INTENDED USE:  
Oxalic Acid Dihydrate is specifically designed for use in beekeeping as a miticide against Varroa destructor. It is suitable for application during the broodless periods of the bee lifecycle, ensuring maximum efficacy and minimal disruption to the colony's growth.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE:  
Administer Oxalic Acid Dihydrate as a vaporization treatment, ensuring proper equipment is used. The recommended dosage is 1.0-1.5 grams per hive, depending on the size and strength of the colony. For application, ensure that hives are free of honey supers and that bees are not present during treatment. Follow manufacturer guidelines for vaporization temperatures and duration to ensure effective mite control.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT:  
Oxalic Acid Dihydrate is classified as a hazardous substance. When handling, wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves, eye protection, and a respirator if necessary. Avoid inhalation, skin contact, and ingestion. In case of accidental exposure, seek medical attention immediately.

REGULATORY STATUS:  
Oxalic Acid Dihydrate is registered as a pesticide under the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) regulations. It is compliant with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidelines and does not require a Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) for use. Check with local state regulations to confirm any additional restrictions or requirements.

SHELF LIFE:  
The shelf life of Oxalic Acid Dihydrate is approximately 2 years when stored properly.

STORAGE:  
Store in a cool, dry place, away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep containers tightly closed when not in use, and out of reach of children and pets.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS:  
For any inquiries or technical questions regarding the use of Oxalic Acid Dihydrate, please contact our technical support team at 1-800-555-0199 or email support@beeproducts.com. Our team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST.

PRODUCT SKU: TRT-FORMIC-R  
PRODUCT NAME: Formic Acid (Registered)  
CATEGORY: Treatments  

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:  
Formic Acid (registered) is a natural organic acid produced by honeybees and is primarily used in beekeeping to control Varroa mites. Its functionality includes disrupting the life cycle of the mites and reducing their population, thereby promoting healthier hives. This treatment is effective in both brood and adult stages of the Varroa mite lifecycle, making it a versatile option for beekeeper use. In addition to mite control, Formic Acid has been shown to have some antimicrobial properties, potentially improving overall hive health.

INTENDED USE:  
Formic Acid is intended for use in beekeeping as a miticide. It is designed to be used in honeybee colonies for the control of Varroa destructor and other pests.

APPLICATION/DOSAGE:  
For effective use, apply **50 mL of Formic Acid per hive** using a commercially available delivery system. The treatment should be conducted during periods of low temperature (between 60°F to 80°F) to minimize evaporation and potential harm to the bees. Repeat applications may be necessary depending on infestation levels. Follow the specific guidelines provided in the product label for optimal results.

LABEL WARNINGS + PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT:  
Formic Acid is corrosive and can cause severe skin burns and eye damage. Always wear appropriate personal protective equipment, including gloves, goggles, and protective clothing, when handling the product. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water for at least 15 minutes. In case of ingestion or inhalation, seek medical attention immediately.

REGULATORY STATUS:  
Formic Acid is registered under the EPA as a pesticide. It is compliant with FDA guidelines for use in honeybee colonies. Check state regulations for any additional restrictions or requirements regarding the use of Formic Acid in your area.

SHELF LIFE:  
The shelf life of Formic Acid (registered) is **2 years** when stored in optimal conditions.

STORAGE:  
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat sources. Keep the container tightly closed and out of reach of children and pets. Do not store near food or feed.

CONTACT FOR TECHNICAL QUESTIONS:  
For further assistance or technical questions regarding Formic Acid, please contact our support team at 1-800-555-0199 or email support@beeproducts.com. Our technical experts are available to assist you Monday through Friday, 8 AM - 5 PM EST.
